First two attempts failed on the shared examples/gw5a/tangmega138k.cst (attosoc's top module only drives clk+led[7:0], not the full 16-led/reset/uart set the cst carries for other designs on this board; then PR2017 dedicated-pin errors on led[0],[1],[3] needing -use_sspi_as_gpio 1, which the Makefile's gowin_pack recipe for this board never needed because nextpnr's --vopt cst= silently drops unmatched/dedicated constraints instead of refusing). Third attempt: cst filtered to the ports attosoc actually drives, plus set_option -use_sspi_as_gpio 1 (harness's own extra_options mechanism, already published for the AE350 shape; oracle.py itself untouched) -- succeeds.
